request.style: English, male baritone solo with acoustic guitar, cello, and light percussion, mournful and ancient, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
In the land of Seir the mountain stood tall
Lotan and Shobal and Zibeon dwell there
Anah and Dishon and Ezer and Dishan
Chiefs of the Horites ruling the domain

[Chorus]
Hemdan and Eshban and Ithran and Cheran
Sons of Dishon walking in the land
Original people before the days were done
Roots in the earth where the sun is set

[Verse]
The descendants of Esau came with their power
They wiped them out and took their place
Just as Israel took the promised land
Dispossessing those who stood in the way

[Chorus]
Hemdan and Eshban and Ithran and Cheran
Sons of Dishon walking in the land
Original people before the days were done
Roots in the earth where the sun is set

[Bridge]
Thirty-eight years the generation passed
The hand of the Lord against the camp
The fighting men perished from the earth
Until the last of the old had left

[Outro]
Hemdan and Eshban and Ithran and Cheran
Sons of Dishon in the memory of man
